name: gravitas
description: > Use for software implementation, debugging, refactoring, review, migration, and other repository-changing engineering work where correctness must be verified. Enforces scoped reconnaissance, adaptive planning, evidence-backed verification, requirement tracking, failure recovery, and budget-aware delegation. Model-agnostic reliability runtime for coding agents -- measured, not claimed.

name: gravitas-highstakes
description: > Mandatory checkpoint skill for irreversible/high-stakes changes (schema migrations, file deletion, auth/security changes, production config, force-pushes). Use when a task risks hard-to-reverse damage.

name: gravitas-perf
description: > Performance analysis mode for GRAVITAS. Adds profiling patterns, benchmark requirements, algorithmic complexity analysis, and before/after measurement protocol. Load for any performance optimization work.

name: gravitas-python
description: > GRAVITAS extension for Python projects. Adds Python-specific recon, type checking with mypy/pyright, ruff/flake8 lint, pytest patterns, and common Python failure modes. Load in addition to the base GRAVITAS skill.

name: gravitas-security
description: > Deep security review mode for GRAVITAS. Adds threat modeling, OWASP Top 10 checks, injection prevention patterns, auth/session security, and security-specific test requirements. Load for any auth, input handling, database, or API work.

name: gravitas-typescript
description: > GRAVITAS extension for TypeScript projects. Adds TypeScript-specific recon, strict mode patterns, Vitest/Jest integration, and common TS failure modes. Load in addition to the base GRAVITAS skill.
